name: g2_binaries_isi
label: ISI at Palomar with MPD PDM 100 um SPADs: Capella and the catalog binaries, 650 and 900 nm, a baseline per night from 5 m to 1 km
notes: Capella (56 mas, two 6-8 mas giants) gives fringes of period lambda/rho = 3.3 m at 900 nm (2.4 m at 650 nm), smeared by the 1.65 m pupils, on the 5-35 m nights; the 1-3 mas binaries (beta Aur, Algol, Spica) need the 300-1000 m nights.
